title: Kissed Yucatecan Shrimp Churros
description: A resinous, bouncy shrimp churro that blends Yucatecan flair with Jamaican curry and fermented kimchi, all in a keto-friendly format.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the minced shrimp, Jamaican curry powder, diced kimchi, salt, pepper, and chili flakes until evenly coated.
Whisk the egg, melted butter, and water together, then stir in almond flour, coconut flour, and xanthan gum until a smooth dough forms.
Fold the shrimp mixture into the dough, ensuring the shrimp are evenly distributed throughout.
Heat 1/2 cup of oil in a deep skillet over medium-high heat until it reaches 350°F (175°C).
Pipe the dough into a pastry bag fitted with a 1/2-inch star tip, forming 3-inch sticks over the hot oil.
Fry the churros until golden brown and puffed, about 2–3 minutes per side, flipping once.
Remove the churros with a slotted spoon and let them drain briefly on paper towels.
Dust the churros with coconut flour and a pinch of curry powder before serving.
